inputClasses: installed template pack id (stub-v1 in the suite)

parameterRanges.dir: path that does not yet hold a project
parameterRanges.name: defaults to the directory name

invariants: init writes revision 0, the input lock (35 schema hashes, template sha256) and the resolved recipe with every pack default explicit
an unknown template is missingCapability (exit 3) and creates no directory
initialising over an existing project is an invalid request that leaves the existing state untouched
a failed validation mid-edit rolls back atomically: no partial value, no revision, no receipt
a replayed request after a simulated crash/restart returns the original result with exactly one receipt
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: revisions are nonnegative integers; timeoutSeconds seconds; maxMemoryMb megabytes; control values in their descriptor units (metres, degrees, normalized)
excluded: native-anime-v1 compile (the stub pack throws notImplemented on compile)

mutants.description: testInitRejectsUnknownTemplateWithExitThreeAndLeavesNoDirectory: an unknown template must exit 3 and leave no project directory behind.
testInitTwiceIsAnInvalidRequestAndNameDefaultsFromDirectory: a second init on the same directory must be an invalid request that changes nothing.
testAtomicRollbackOnFailedValidationMidEdit: a multi-value edit with one invalid value must apply nothing: state byte-identical, revision list [0], no receipt.
testCrashRestartReplayReturnsOriginalResult: the same requestId replayed through a freshly reopened context must return the original envelope with exactly one receipt.

visual.applicabilityRecord: project init is a revision-0 transaction over the project store and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.
